title: NGS Library Prep: KAPA Hyper Plus 96rx, cat 07962428001 ROCHE - part 1 of 2 - Fragmentation, End Repair, Adapter Ligation, Library Amplification
author: Opentrons
materials: With this protocol, your robot can perform the ROCHE KAPA HyperPlus NGS library prep protocol described by the [KAPA HyperPlus Kit](https://www.n-genetics.com/products/1104/1023/17277.pdf). This is part 1 of the protocol, which includes the steps (

steps.title: Enzymatic DNA fragmentation
steps.instruction: Combine Frag‑MM with the DNA sample, then incubate at 37 °C.

steps.title: End repair and A‑tailing
steps.instruction: Add ERAT‑MM to the fragmented DNA and incubate at 65 °C.

steps.title: Adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Add Liga‑MM to the end‑repaired DNA and incubate at 20 °C.

steps.title: Post‑ligation cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform the post‑ligation purification as described in the kit protocol.

steps.title: Prepare PCR amplification mix
steps.instruction: Combine KAPA mix, the purified library, and the P7 and P5 adapters.

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Run the PCR program on the thermocycler module according to the kit instructions.
